## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm run validate` pass locally
- [ ] Every SOP step has an autonomy level at or below the SOP's `max_autonomy`
- [ ] No hard stop is automated
- [ ] Skills refer to capabilities, not products, and work without a connector
- [ ] No real customer, personal or deal data
- [ ] New practices note where they come from (experience or a cited source)
